operation.summary: Create an owner budget. This device is its executor and holds the whole amount as a standing share. Needs the Budgets capability; explicit owner.configuration grant required

body.name: namespace
body.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

body.name: scope
body.description: {kind: account|device|instrument|service|applet|agent, id}. account and device need no id (device is this device); an instrument must be one of this namespace

body.name: period
body.description: hour, day, week or month, in the rule document's time zone

body.name: amount
body.description: The budget per period: {unit, atoms} (a whole number of the unit's smallest part) or {unit, amount} (plain decimal text); USD-6 is millionths of a dollar

body.name: rebalance
body.description: Rebalance shares between devices by use (default true)

body.name: gate
body.description: {agents_may_change: boolean, ceiling: money or null}. Under a ceiling this device's headroom balance is the whole room between the amount and the ceiling

body.name: generation
body.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

operation.returns: budget{id, scope{kind,id}, period, unit, amount (what stands for good), base, total (with this period's top-ups), rebalance, gate{agents_may_change, ceiling, set_by, gate_strength agent|grants|approver}, portions{cloud, devices{install:{portion, kind, headroom}}}, this_device{portion, headroom, used, remaining, period_id, resets_at, standing current|unanchored|not_open, frozen, holds_reclaim}, increments[], in_transit[], taken[]}, generation

generation.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

rebalance.description: Rebalance shares between devices by use (default true)

period.description: hour, day, week or month, in the rule document's time zone

amount.description: The budget per period: {unit, atoms} (a whole number of the unit's smallest part) or {unit, amount} (plain decimal text); USD-6 is millionths of a dollar

scope.description: {kind: account|device|instrument|service|applet|agent, id}. account and device need no id (device is this device); an instrument must be one of this namespace

namespace.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

gate.description: {agents_may_change: boolean, ceiling: money or null}. Under a ceiling this device's headroom balance is the whole room between the amount and the ceiling
